overview: The committee reviewed the Medford Police Department's report on the Welcoming City Ordinance and debated how to track ICE detainer requests without compromising resident privacy. The body discussed increasing reporting frequency and providing a quantitative tally of federal immigration enforcement actions.

items.title: Welcoming City Ordinance Report and ICE Detainer Tracking
items.summary: Kept the Welcoming City Ordinance report in committee following a discussion on improving the tracking of ICE detainers to increase transparency while protecting resident privacy. Chief Buckley explained that the department does not assist ICE in custodial arrests and agreed that a quantitative tally of detainer requests could be included in future reports.

subject: Welcoming City Ordinance and ICE Detainer Tracking
